profile.speaker_bass.desc: Natural speakers with a little more low end.
profile.bass_lift.desc: More low end. Best with earphones.
profile.clear_voice.desc: Brings out speech and takes away some boom.

blend.title: Speaker Fix
about.title: FroggySoundTuner
about.p1: Pick a preset on the first tab, or fine-tune your own sound on the Equalizer tab and save it as a preset. Press [X] to play a test sound so you can hear the difference.
about.p2: Your choice stays on while you play games and use other apps. It switches off when the device is turned off, so open FroggySoundTuner again after starting up.
about.p3: If you don't like how it sounds, press [Y] at any time to go back to the normal sound.
about.p4: To rename or delete a preset you made, select it on the first tab and press [Select].
about.p5: Press [B], or [Select + Start]. Your games and saves are never changed.
fix.intro: This device's built-in speakers only play the right side of stereo sound, so some music and sound effects go missing. Speaker Fix mixes left and right together so you hear everything.
fix.auto.desc: Fixes the speakers, and leaves earphones alone.
fix.on.desc: Mixes left and right all the time.
fix.off.desc: Normal stereo, as the device makes it.
fix.now_speakers: Right now: the built-in speakers are in use.
fix.now_phones: Right now: earphones are plugged in.
fix.now_unknown: Right now: can't tell if earphones are plugged in.
fix.scope: Saved for the programs that support it, which are not all of them yet. Emulators have their own "Mono output" option in their pause menu.
